title: Commercial Insurance Sales Executive
salary_text: £40000 - £50000 per year (+ 5% commission on all sales)
description:
Commercial Insurance Sales Executive
Takeley, Essex £40,000 £50,000 Basic + Commission Permanent

Do you have a successful track record in insurance sales and enjoy building relationships that turn into long-term business?

CKB Recruitment is working with an established insurance agency in Takeley to recruit a Commercial Insurance Sales Executive.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of your new business activity within an ambitious, supportive team. You ll build relationships with business owners and decision-makers, understand their insurance requirements and develop solutions that demonstrate the value of quality cover and personal service.

Experienced account handlers will support the clients you bring on board through their renewals, giving you confidence in the ongoing service behind your sales.

The opportunity

You ll play a key role in growing the agency s commercial client base, focusing on businesses outside the farming sector.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Generating your own opportunities and maintaining a consistent pipeline of commercial prospects.
- Building relationships with business owners, directors and key decision-makers.
- Understanding each client s business and presenting tailored insurance solutions.
- Converting prospects into clients through a consultative sales approach.
- Identifying cross-selling opportunities across motor and personal insurance, risk management and financial services.
- Maintaining accurate records using the CRM system and working within a regulated environment.
- Working closely with account handlers to support a smooth handover and ongoing client service.

What we re looking for

An insurance sales background is essential, alongside a proven track record of winning new business.

You ll be proactive, commercially aware and comfortable creating your own opportunities. You ll also bring:
- Confident communication and relationship-building skills.
- The ability to explain the value of cover and service clearly.
- A self-motivated approach and the drive to maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
- A commitment to excellent customer service and long-term relationships.
- The ability to learn products quickly and retain technical information.
- Confidence using business software and CRM systems.

You ll also need at least five GCSEs, including English Language and Mathematics, meeting the employer s stated minimum grade requirements.

The package
- £40,000 £50,000 basic salary, depending on experience.
- 5% commission on commercial new business sold.
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- An additional day off for your birthday.
- Health cash plan following successful completion of probation.
- Full product training, with potential financial support towards professional qualifications.
- A supportive team with experienced account handlers looking after renewal business.

Working hours: Monday to Friday, 9am 5pm, with a one-hour lunch break. Reduced or condensed hours may be considered for an exceptional candidate.

To explore the opportunity, apply with your CV through CKB Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

title: Key Account Executive
description:
About Us
At IronmongeryDirect, we've been a trusted name in architectural ironmongery for over 50 years. What started as a traditional ironmongery shop has since grown into the UK's leading direct supplier, delivering thousands of parcels each week. With a vast range of over 18,000 high-quality products available for next-day delivery, we're the reliable choice for tradespeople who value efficiency, expert advice, and top-tier service. If you're looking to be part of a dynamic, growing company that's built on a foundation of trust and excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role
Are you passionate about building meaningful relationships and driving business growth? We're looking for a Key Account Executive to join our Key Account Management (KAM) Team-a high-energy, collaborative team dedicated to helping our customers succeed and drive sales.

This role isn't just about sales; it's about understanding customers' needs, solving challenges, and creating long-term partnerships that fuel mutual success. You'll thrive in a fast-paced, supportive environment where best practices are shared, ideas are valued, and success is celebrated.

This is a proactive, telephone-based sales role where making outbound calls will be a significant part of your day. You'll be expected to regularly contact existing, dormant and prospective customers to understand their requirements, introduce our products and services, identify sales opportunities and encourage repeat business.

We offer a hybrid working model, with two days in the office and three from home, giving you the flexibility to work in a way that suits you. On top of that, we have a clear and achievable bonus structure that rewards your performance, ensuring your hard work is recognised. Most importantly, you'll be part of a dynamic and collaborative culture where your impact truly matters.

If you're motivated, resilient, and love building relationships that make a difference, we'd love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities
- Proactively make a high volume of outbound telephone calls to existing, dormant and prospective customers, with the aim of attracting new business, re-engaging customers and generating sales opportunities.
- Reporting into the Key Account Team Manager, you will develop existing Key Account Customer relationships to drive up revenue, average order value (AOV) and order frequency, whilst maintaining gross profit (GP) margins. This will include elements such as cross selling, add selling etc.
- You will manage your own designated Key Accounts to ensure consistent exceptional service. WOWing customers should be central to your approach and keeping clear, detailed notes from discussions into Hubspot is also vital for future success.
- Actively identify and pursue opportunities to win back lapsed customers, understand reasons for reduced purchasing activity and encourage customers to return to IronmongeryDirect.
- You will have your finger on the pulse with your KAM customers ensuring you are tracking account performance, ensuring targets are met or exceeded.
- You will plan and manage your monthly and quarterly sales strategy of target accounts and outreach plans.
- Provide valuable customer feedback and insights to wider business, including providing future product onboarding through customer feedback.
- Working closely with internal teams to ensure swift issue resolution and seamless customer service.
- Sharing customer insights with our Marketing and Category Management teams to develop the right value propositions and product features to expand into your target market.
- Working towards KPI's for KAM tasks on customer contact to ensure timely responses.

About You
- 2+ years of experience in a fast-paced B2 B environment, with a strong understanding of customer needs and business growth.
- Confident and comfortable making a high volume of outbound telephone calls, with the ability to engage customers, generate interest and create sales opportunities.
- Experience managing key accounts, fostering long-term relationships, and delivering tailored solutions.
- Clear and concise communicator, both verbal and written, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels.
- Demonstrated success in consistently meeting and surpassing sales targets, with a results-driven approach.
- High emotional intelligence and the ability to build rapport and trust with clients and colleagues alike.
- Confident in addressing objections and skilled in negotiating mutually beneficial agreements.
- Ability to thrive in dynamic, high-pressure environments while maintaining focus on team success.
- Proven ability to develop and implement account strategies aligned with overarching business objectives.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and data analysis for identifying trends and opportunities.
- Driven to succeed with a proactive mindset and a strong desire to achieve both personal and team goals.

What We Offer
- 25 days annual leave plus public bank holidays.
- Hybrid working arrangements
- 40 hours of training & development investment per employee annually.
- Private healthcare (subsidised) for employees and their families.
- Health & Wellbeing support via Health Shield, including claim-back medical costs, EAP services, GP Anytime, and more
- Individual performance-related annual bonus.
- Quarterly WOW awards for outstanding contributions.
- Staff discounts on our extensive product range.
- Long service awards.
- Two paid volunteer days per year.
- 500 refer-a-friend incentive scheme.
- Free onsite parking at our Head Office.

Become a part of the IronmongeryDirect team, where expertise, collaboration, and customer success are at the heart of everything we do. Apply now and take the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic, fast-growing environment!

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Technical Sales Account Manager

Location: Outskirts of Braintree, Essex
Salary: 40,000 to 45,000 basic, plus commission with 75,000+ OTE
Contract: Full time, permanent
Working arrangements: Hybrid
Benefits: Company car, laptop and mobile phone

Are you a commercially driven sales professional with a technical background? This is an opportunity to take ownership of an established customer portfolio, develop new business and grow your earnings within a successful specialist equipment business.

Our client supplies technical equipment and supporting technology to customers across the UK. With an established customer base and opportunities for further growth, they are looking for a motivated individual who enjoys building relationships and helping customers find the right solutions.

The Role

You will manage and develop existing accounts while identifying new sales opportunities. Combining relationship management with a consultative approach, you will understand customer requirements, recommend suitable products and manage enquiries from initial discussion through to confirmed orders.

This is a varied position involving customer visits, product demonstrations, quotations and commercial negotiations. Product training will be provided, making this an opportunity for someone who can bring technical understanding and a proven ability to sell.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and grow an established portfolio of customers, building relationships with key contacts and decision makers.
- Identify new business opportunities through customer engagement, research and proactive prospecting.
- Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable technical products and services.
- Review technical specifications and enquiries to prepare appropriate solutions.
- Produce accurate quotations and proposals.
- Conduct customer visits, meetings, product demonstrations and presentations.
- Follow up opportunities, negotiate commercial terms and secure orders.
- Maintain accurate CRM records, manage your sales pipeline and provide reliable forecasts.
- Work closely with internal technical, engineering and commercial teams to support successful delivery.
- Provide initial product advice and coordinate further technical support where required.
- Attend relevant exhibitions, networking events and industry meetings.

About You
- Proven experience in B2 B sales, account management or business development.
- A technical background, ideally gained through selling technical products, equipment or services.
- Strong communication, relationship management and negotiation skills.
- A proactive approach to developing existing accounts and winning new business.
- Confidence understanding technical information and explaining solutions clearly.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple opportunities independently.
- A practical approach to solving problems and supporting customers.
- Experience using CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
- A full UK driving licence.

Experience preparing technical proposals, reviewing specifications or delivering product demonstrations would be beneficial.

Working Arrangements and Benefits

The role typically involves three days in the office,

Occasional overnight stays may be required for customer meetings and events, with business travel and accommodation expenses covered.

You will receive:
- 40,000 to 45,000 basic salary.
- Commission scheme offering 75,000+ OTE.
- Company car, laptop and mobile phone.
- Hybrid working arrangements.
- Specialist product training and ongoing development.
- An established customer portfolio with scope to develop new business.

Apply now if you enjoy technical sales, building lasting customer relationships and taking ownership of your success.
